Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class FileRunViewSource

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.FileRunViewSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
RunViewSource
public final class FileRunViewSource extends Object implements RunViewSource
A RunViewSource over one growing JSON Lines file, one event per line, paged through a FileLineIndex.

Path safety. The application supplies the Path when it builds the source; nothing in a request ever becomes a path. An application that derives paths from ids must resolve them against a fixed root, normalize() the result, and require result.startsWith(root).

Numbering. seq is the 1-based line number. A seq member in the file is ignored and overwritten, so the producer writes events without one. A line that is not valid JSON, is not a known event, or is too long is skipped: it consumes its line number, so a gap appears in seq. The first such line a source meets is logged once as a WARNING, with its line number; later ones are skipped without a log record, so a corrupt file polled every second does not flood the log. Blank lines are not counted as malformed.

Tokens are <epoch>.<n>: the epoch of the file generation and the last line number consumed. A stale epoch (the file was truncated, replaced or rewritten) or an n beyond the indexed lines throws UnknownTokenException. This includes a token issued while the file did not exist yet, once the file has been created.

Only complete lines are read, so a partially written last line never appears. Keep one instance per file; a new instance re-indexes the file from byte 0.

Example:

FileRunViewSource src = FileRunViewSource.create(root.resolve("run-42.jsonl")) .terminal(() -> run.isFinished()) .build();
